rationale: itnet_v3-claude-agentic: itnet_k=2, unet_c=24, alpha_init=0.0025734, lr=0.00021567, epochs=5, batch_size=2, train_n=2400, val_n=200, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=1100, seed=44, rationale=iter-17 (breast-ct redo, search-20260703-01). THIRD bs=2 seed replicate of the c24/ep5/bs2/lr2.16e-4 champion config. ONE KNOB: seed 43 -> 44. All else = iter-7/16 config exactly. SIX-BOX (NUMBERS): (1) FINDING confirmed: itnet_v3 breast is HIGH-VARIANCE across seeds at BOTH batch sizes. bs=1: s42 0.8638, s43 0.7983, s44 0.6142. bs=2: s42 0.8469, s43 0.6699. Every run converges to train loss 1e-6 yet val hr swings ~0.2 -- end-to-end unrolled training finds different-generalizing minima; seed 42 is favorable for both. iter-16's falsifier FIRED (bs=2 also swings>0.05) -> the reported champion MUST be a multi-seed mean+/-std, not a single peak. (2) FAILURE MODE: high generalization variance intrinsic to the recipe (not a bug -- train loss is stable). Building the bs=2 mean+/-std as the reportable number. (3) ONE KNOB: seed 43 -> 44 (3rd bs=2 point). (4) HYPOTHESIS: n/a for a variance replicate; seed 44 refines the bs=2 spread. Provisional bs=2 mean after this = mean(0.8469, 0.6699, s44). (5) BUDGET (HARD 20min=1200s): bs=2 config = iter-7 939.5s / iter-16 1096.9s, both < 1200s (bs=2 has ~2-4min margin vs bs=1's wall-hugging 19.85-20.6min). max_train_s=1100 fences the TRAIN phase. train_n=2400 (<= OOM-safe cap). val=200 distinct val_truth.h5 cases, 256px inscribed-circle FOV (breast default). (6) do NOT return control mid-campaign; gate on iter-17 numeric-headroom obs via iter_wait.sh v3 then dispatch iter-18.
